verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a fraud and chargeback SaaS like Forter, for example bulk-updating order statuses or acting on many disputes at once, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents per-order APIs (order decision, order status), per-claim evidence submission, per-event webhooks, and an MCP server for individual natural-language actions. Nothing documents a batch or bulk endpoint, or any way to act on many items in one operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
